youtube.title: Why Manhole Covers Are Round 🕳️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Manhole covers are round for one clever reason.

A square cover can fall through its own hole along the diagonal. A circle is the same width in every direction, so a heavy cast iron cover can never drop on the workers below. Round covers also roll and never need lining up.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
